item.title: PXE Booting Raspberry Pi 4 with Synology and Ubiquiti EdgeRouter
item.description: I love Raspbery Pis - I have done since they first released them, all the way up to the present iteration, the Raspberry Pi 4. They’re phenominal little bits of kit, endlessly hackable and because of their really low price, they open up computing to a huge number of people who otherwise wouldn’t get the opportunity.
